sections.sub: Chọn hoặc điền từ / cụm từ đã học.

sections.title: Part 2 · Reading — Three short emails
sections.sub: Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi.
sections.passage:
Hi Mr Brown,
I'm sorry, but I need to reschedule our appointment. It's on Wednesday the 13th at 2:30, but I'm meeting a client then. I have a busy schedule this week. Are you available on Thursday the 14th? Does 10 a.m. work for you?
Best, Mai

Hi Mai,
No problem. Unfortunately, I'm not available on Thursday morning because I have a deadline. But there is an available time slot on Friday the 15th at 3:15. Does that work for you?
Best, David Brown

Hi Mr Brown,
Yes, Friday works for me. Let me confirm: Friday the 15th at 3:15. See you then!
Mai

sections.title: Part 3 · Listening — Hoa's voicemail
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: Why is Hoa postponing the meeting?
New day: ____
New date: the ____
New time: ____

sections.audioHint: Nghe 2 lần, ghi lại thông tin.
script: Hi Nam, it's Hoa. Unfortunately, I'm meeting a client on Monday morning, so we are postponing our team meeting. Could we move it to Tuesday the 30th at half past ten instead? Does that work for you? Call me back. Thanks!

sections.title: Part 3 · Listening — Booking a yoga class
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: Why is the 7 p.m. class no good?
Why doesn't 8:15 work for Ken?
options: He's having dinner with his family.
answers: He's having dinner with his family.
items.show: He's having dinner with his family.

items.prompt: Date: Thursday the ____
Time: ____

sections.audioHint: Nghe 2 lần, điền phiếu đặt lịch.
script: Good afternoon, City Gym. How can I help you?
Hi. I need to make an appointment for a yoga class, please. Are you available on Wednesday evening?
Let me check. Unfortunately, the 7 p.m. class is full. We have an available time slot at 8:15.
8:15 doesn't work for me. I'm having dinner with my family then. Do you have a time slot on Thursday?
The 19th? Yes. Let me confirm: Thursday the 19th at 6:30.
That's right. What's your name, please?
Thank you, Mr Lee. See you on Thursday!

sections.title: Part 4 · Speaking — Shadowing
sections.sub: Nghe mẫu → đọc theo → ghi âm. Máy chấm điểm trên thang 10 và tô màu từng từ.

items.prompt: Leave a voicemail to reschedule a meeting

sentences.text: I'm calling about our meeting on Monday.
Unfortunately, I have a busy schedule on Monday, and I'm meeting a client in the afternoon.
Could we move it to Wednesday the 13th instead?
I'm available after 2 p.m. Does 3:30 work for you?
Call me back, and let me confirm the time. Thanks!
